Step R2 of fz-9zq. Page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-9zq.2.html. Buys: Enum.reduce([1,2], :start, fn x, acc -> {x, acc} end) compiles and prints {2, {1, :start}}; so do reduce_cons_tuple, w1 (two chains sharing reduce_step), v1 ({x,acc} and {acc,x} reducers together), v2, c1/c2 (user-written cycles) and t4b. Closes fz-y5x with it (same defect: call_key_types returns the arguments untouched when caller.function != function).

Diagnosis (fresh look, 2026-11-17; scratch 9zq_2/fresh/, predictions.md):
- "Widen against an ancestor" is the wrong frame: a shared-fact engine has no call stack, so any ancestor rule depends on job order (design A: w1 gives 2 plans; the shared CallPattern table: 4 plans in 12 orders).
- The self-call rule already on develop is order-free: a slot the recursion supplies keeps the caller's key column, the arguments still join the evidence row, and R1's fold ends the ascent. A self-recursive reduce compiles on develop, w1 included.
- Two gaps remain. (1) The rule is self-call only, so List.reduce_cont <-> reduce_step mints a key per rung. (2) The clash head carried the first-slot atom tag; that is fz-9zq.10.

The rule (spike fresh/K7.diff, base 9754e64d9):
- BodyKeying.cycle_supplied (slot bitmask) on the Recursive fact. derive_recursive finds the cycle members (reach members that reach back), waits on their LoweredBody, and runs a least fixpoint over every direct call among members: a position (function, slot, path) is supplied when it is held nowhere or only at supplied positions; an opaque value supplies its position deep; a rebuilt tuple supplies its own position only.
- ActivationKey.entry: Option<(FunctionId, Ty)>, the entering activation's function and arrow. It takes part in SemanticOrd for ActivationKey and ExecutableSymbol, in ActivationSymbol, and in the transport resolution filter.
- call_key: no argument carries a constructor -> plain key, no fact asked. Otherwise, for a call inside the callee's cycle: a call back to the entry function takes the entry's own columns at supplied slots; a call to another member keys supplied slots as any and carries the entry.
- World::require_call_key_facts asks Recursive(callee) alongside the keying facts, only for calls whose arguments carry a constructor. Roots ask nothing new. (Asking on every call raised exception cost 210 -> 240 and broke the 1 + 2 untaken-arm test; asking from roots broke a macro-root test.)
- Removed: supplied_whole_slots, recursion_supplied_positions, collect_rebuild_obligations (the self-call special case is the one-member cycle).

Measured on the spike: every probe correct; K7 gives 1 plan in 12 job orders on each of 15 probes, t4b included (o2/K7.summary); fixture_matrix behaviour green; distiller 16.04B -> 13.84B instructions, same output. 19 lib pins move, almost all falls.

Open before the build:
- Rises: 00420 static reach (68,112) -> (69,113); 00181 formula evaluations 936 -> 954; yield sizes 32,224 -> 32,256 bytes. Causes not yet named.
- One UncausedEvaluation on 00567: the public trace's activation identity does not include the entry.
- Six tests on 00419/00420 lose their subject (no multi-member construction wrapper is published any more).
- bst (fz-9zq.11) still hangs.

Earlier refuted approaches (H1 re-key evidence, H2 hidden table, fact-backed CallPattern, design A + T, ancestry fact W) are in scratch 9zq_2/r/report.md, 9zq_2/disc/, 9zq_2/ord/, 9zq_2/anc/.
title: A call inside a recursion cycle keeps the entering activation's key at the slots the cycle supplies
